implementationAliases.purpose: Bright brand decoration and soft highlights. PWA foregrounds and selection marks use the theme-aware primary-on-surface role.
Theme-aware PWA labels, icons, navigation indicators and selection controls: tertiary-action in light, tertiary-dark mint in the dark PWA (DL-088; PRD-1150).
Dark green ink token. Not used for text on bright tertiary fills; those use the tertiary-action pair (DL-017).
Contrast-safe green fills: tertiary-action with white in light; tertiary-dark with on-tertiary-dark ink in the dark PWA (DL-088).
Light PWA filled-action hover. Dark PWA hover uses tertiary-dark-hover.
Light PWA and non-PWA green-fill foreground. Dark PWA fills use on-tertiary-dark ink.
Pale mint foregrounds and filled actions with near-black ink, scoped to PWA and Storybook app surfaces (DL-088).

implementationAliases.implementation: --gg-radius-* only; no shared Tailwind rounded-* override
implementationAliases.purpose: Canonical radius outputs without changing existing client rounded utilities.

pwaProtection.primaryRole: DesignMD colors.primary is ink/charcoal and must not be mapped to --color-primary.
pwaProtection.tertiaryRole: DesignMD colors.tertiary supplies bright brand decoration; dark PWA controls use colors.tertiary-dark.
pwaProtection.actionRole: PWA green fills use colors.tertiary-action with white in light and colors.tertiary-dark with on-tertiary-dark ink in dark.
pwaProtection.shellFreeze: Token generation must not change AppShell height, bottom AppBar behavior, safe-area padding, or /home/garden and /home/:id/work/:workId AppBar hiding.
